title: Gemini Can Import Your ChatGPT Chats | Free AI Tool #1 📦
description:
Gemini can import your whole ChatGPT chat history from one ZIP file, so you can switch without starting over. Export your data in ChatGPT (Settings, Data controls, Export), then in Gemini open Import memory and add the ZIP under Import chats: up to 5 GB per file and 5 files a day. It also works with Claude, and a copy-paste prompt brings over what your old AI remembers about you. Works on personal Google accounts, 18+, on web and the Gemini app; not yet in the EU, UK or Switzerland.

Would you switch from ChatGPT to Gemini? Tell us in the comments!

🔔 Follow AI Daily Drop for a new free AI tool every Tuesday.

Source: Google, "ICYMI: Transfer your history from other AI apps into Gemini" (November 19, 2026) and Gemini Help, "Import from other AI platforms to Gemini Apps"; MacRumors (launch coverage)

scenes.say: One ZIP file moves your whole ChatGPT history into Gemini. Here's how.

footage.q: Google official Switch to Gemini promo image

scenes.title: Export it
scenes.subtitle: ChatGPT: Settings > Data controls.
scenes.say: In ChatGPT, open Settings, then Data controls, and tap Export. You get a ZIP file.

scenes.title: Import it
scenes.subtitle: Gemini: Import memory > Add.
scenes.say: In Gemini, open Import memory, tap Add under Import chats, and pick that ZIP.

footage.q: Google official mockup of importing chats into Gemini

scenes.label: per file, 5 files a day
scenes.say: Up to five gigabytes per file, five files a day. It works for Claude chats too.

scenes.title: No paid plan
scenes.subtitle: 18+, not in EU or UK yet.
scenes.say: No paid plan needed. You must be eighteen, and it's not in Europe or the UK yet.
